name: חָרָן
summary: Chiefly the place where Terah and his household settled on their way from Ur to Canaan, where Terah died and from which Abram set out. A son of Caleb by Ephah bears the same spelling. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: עַד חָרָן marks the point the travelers reached. שָׁם refers back to Haran as the place where they settled.
In וַיָּמָת תֶּרַח בְּחָרָן, the preposition בְּ marks Haran as the place where Terah died.
In בְּצֵאתוֹ מֵחָרָן, מֵ־ marks Haran as the place Abram left.
In אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ בְחָרָן, בְ marks Haran as the place where the household had acquired the people who went with Abram.

note: Moved from the former word entry `7aaraan`. The old root key חרנ recorded the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain. Haran@1Ch.2.46 (חָרָן) is added as a second bearer of the spelling; Abram’s brother Haran is הָרָן, another name.
